Wholesale Only: ISSEI LLC sells to businesses purchasing for resale. Orders are not binding until confirmed by us in writing.Pricing: Prices are those on our wholesale price list in effect when your order is confirmed, exclusive of shipping and tax.Price Changes: We may revise our price list on sixty (60) days' written notice. New prices apply only to orders confirmed on or after the effective date.Payment: Orders are payable before shipment unless we extend written credit terms, in which case invoices are net fourteen (14) days.Shipping and Risk of Loss: All shipments are FOB Origin. Title and risk of loss pass to you when products are delivered to the carrier. ISSEI LLC is not responsible for packages lost, stolen, delayed, misdelivered, or damaged in transit, or delivered to an incorrect address you supplied. We will assist with a carrier claim as a courtesy. We ship within the United States only.Returns: Products are food items and are sold final sale. Shortages, incorrect items, and transit damage must be reported within five (5) business days of delivery with photographs.Liability: OUR TOTAL LIABILITY ON ANY ORDER SHALL NOT EXCEED THE AMOUNT PAID FOR THE PRODUCTS GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM.

What Are Cookies? Cookies are small files placed on your device to collect standard internet activity and visitor behavior.Types of Cookies Used:Essential Cookies: Necessary for the core function of the Site (e.g., navigation).Analytics Cookies: Used to help us understand how the Site is used (e.g., tracking usage).Functional Cookies: Used to remember your preferences.Management: You can manage or disable cookies using your browser settings. Note that disabling cookies may prevent certain features of the Site from working correctly.
